name: Orchestrator
description: Coordinate multi-agent workflows by fanning out to parallel Agent nodes on the canvas, with a dedicated 'done' output called only when all jobs finish.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.label: Goal
inputs.placeholder: Conduct 4-way PR review and security audit

inputs.name: agentOutputs
inputs.label: Agent Outputs
inputs.helpText: Configured agent outputs to connect to Agent nodes on the canvas. Each entry dynamically generates an output socket on the block, alongside the 'done' socket that only triggers when all jobs finish.

inputs.name: sharedInput
inputs.label: Shared Input
inputs.helpText: Optional context provided to every delegated agent.

inputs.name: requireResearchOutput
inputs.label: Require Research Finding Contract
inputs.helpText: Require each delegated research agent to return findings with claim, evidence, source URL, date, confidence, limitations, area, and question IDs.

inputs.name: maxToolStepsPerAgent
inputs.label: Tool Steps Per Agent
inputs.helpText: Upper bound on search and page-reading calls for each delegated agent.

inputs.name: failFast
inputs.label: Fail on Agent Error
inputs.helpText: Stop sequential delegation on the first error or fail the parallel result after active agents finish.

inputs.name: agents
inputs.label: Legacy Sub-Agents JSON
inputs.helpText: Optional legacy array of {id, role, task, model, allowedTools} for self-contained execution without canvas nodes.
